subject: Simulation of a membrane containing system in implicit solvent

messages.author: Sergey Samsonov
messages.body:
Dear AMBERs,
I wonder if it is feasible to perform an implicit solvent simulation of a transmembrane protein with the lipid bilayer membrane included?
Thank you in advance and best regards,
Sergey
